HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW:KING KASEY (3) is a fast beginner and has been recording fast times at his recent victories so he will take catching if he can find the lead. JOE GOT ROLLED (1) is rising in class on his past two runner up performances but he is a speedy type and is likely to gain the perfect trip behind the leader so he must be respected. WOTDIDUSAAAY (9) races best when he is able to lead so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he is racing too well to dismiss. He recorded victories at Echuca and Cranbourne, missed out at Melton then performed nicely at a Melton trial third since. The interesting runner is the former New Zealand pacer AMALFI (11) for trainer Carson Millar. He is poorly drawn but his form across the Tasman is strong enough to suggest he can be competitive and he was placed in two Melton trials back in September. OCEAN AVENUE (7) produced a career best performance when second in a strong race at Melton last outing and is not without a chance in a quality field. SELECTIONS: KING KASEY (3), JOE GOT ROLLED (1), WOTDIDUSAAAY (9), AMALFI (11)

OVERVIEW:BRAVE ART (9) began quickly to lead and was taken on early with the first quarter being a sensational 26.5 seconds so her effort to finish third at Ballarat last outing was very brave. She appears to be well graded in this event and should prove very hard to beat. TUKURUA (3) is resuming since March but she was competing against much stronger opposition when she was last in work. She is nicely drawn first up and should run a good race. TORQUE INTHEUSA (7) was confidently supported and ran a cheeky race after working to the front when second at Hamilton last week. He is not as well drawn for this assignment but is worth thought again. PRETTY BASIC (8) was resuming since a Hamilton victory in April when fifth behind My Atlantis last week. He should be fitter from that performance and is worth following. BACK: BRAVE ART (9) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BRAVE ART (9), TUKURUA (3), TORQUE INTHEUSA (7), PRETTY BASIC (8)

OVERVIEW: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6) is a strong type, which has been placed in four of her five starts to date and deserves to break through for a win. She raced without cover throughout when third behind Pet Wolf in a slick mile rate of 1.54.9 at Melton two starts ago, which is a good form pointer for this event. BANGBANG BOBBIE (7) is backing up quickly from his effort at St Arnaud on Sunday but his form is good enough to be competitive here. He finished second behind the smart juvenile pacer Lambro Louella at Mount Gambier on October 30. SUBATOMIC (2) ran into a distant second behind Witha Bitta Luck at Mount Gambier when on debut and is worth a place ticket from her good draw. JOKIC (5) is resuming since a debut fifth a Bendigo in May. He has performed fairly well at the trials with a win and a third at Maryborough to his credit and he is worth thought in multiple combinations. BACK: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MYDEEPESTDESIRE (6), BANGBANG BOBBIE (7), SUBATOMIC (2), JOKIC (5)

OVERVIEW: ANOTHER WOODS (8) is resuming since an unplaced effort at Geelong in June but will be fitter for a recent unplaced Terang trial performance. He ran some big races against handy grade during his last preparation and recorded a mile rate of 1.55.5 at his last victory so he should be competitive if he is somewhere near his peak. FIVE CENT (6) raced without cover throughout when a creditable third behind Assigned two starts ago. He is a strong staying type and is worth thought under these conditions. BOBBYS ROOM (2) was held up for a run at a vital stage when a handy third behind Huxham Chubb last outing. He should be ready to strike his peak form after having two starts back from a break and is drawn to go well. A ROCKNROLL JET (1) battled on nicely after racing without cover throughout when fifth at Charlton last outing. He is much better drawn for this assignment and is capable of improving on his numerical form. SELECTIONS: ANOTHER WOODS (8), FIVE CENT (6), BOBBYS ROOM (2), A ROCKNROLL JET (1)

OVERVIEW:BUBBLE OVER (2) was resuming since May when she finished off nicely for third in fast final sectionals behind Colosimo at Terang. She should be better after that performance and is drawn to go close. MY FATAL CHARM (1) is a former Tasmanian pacer, which joins trainer Carson Millar. She is ideally drawn and was placed behind the handy pacer Our Ultimate Gracy two starts ago so she must be kept safe. MAJOR ROY (3) is a tough campaigner, which should make his presence felt. He trailed the leader and chased hard when a close second behind Billys Tiger Khan at Ballarat two starts ago. DARETODANCE (6) and MISSMALACHITE (7) are both racing well enough to figure in the finish despite being drawn widely. SELECTIONS: BUBBLE OVER (2), MY FATAL CHARM (1), MAJOR ROY (3), MISSMALACHITE (7)

OVERVIEW:CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (8) is a tough type and should be competitive against this line up. She raced without cover and got the better of Nedza Thriller to win at Ballarat three starts ago and went down fighting at Maryborough last outing. BETSY ANNE (5) led out then took cover mid-race when she got up to win at Maryborough last outing. She has been placed at her past four attempts and is worth thought again. ALLWATFUNJINGLES (6) is backing up quickly from his effort at Melton on Friday but he finished off well for second at Melton on October 23 so he is not without a chance. BROWN EYED KATE (2) has been placed in two of her past four starts and she is drawn to gain a trail just off the speed so she is worth thought. SELECTIONS: CHILLHUNNYBUNNY (8), BETSY ANNE (5), ALLWATFUNJINGLES (6), BROWN EYED KATE (2)

OVERVIEW: DESERT VIPER (3) was performing well at the trials prior a handy debut fourth behind Whitering, where she raced without cover throughout. She should have benefited from the experience and is worth thought again. CARPOPHORUS (8) is a former Queenslander, which was resuming since April when an eye-catching sixth at his Victorian debut, where he finished quickly from last. He is yet to be placed in 16 starts but his first up run was encouraging and he warrants respect. SINCEILEFTYOU (4) is a nicely bred first starter, which scored at a Melton trial effort last week and has the ability to give a forward showing. PETITE FOUR (2) finished a distant fourth when resuming at Charlton and is a minor place possibility from her good draw. SELECTIONS: DESERT VIPER (3), CARPOPHORUS (8), SINCEILEFTYOU (4), PETITE FOUR (2)

OVERVIEW: SMOKEN STREPO (6) produced a career best performance when he led throughout and scored by a large margin in a mile rate of 1.57.2 at Terang two starts ago. He is a short course specialist and should give a forward showing. NORMANDY NUGGET (2) performs best when he is close to the speed so he is perfectly drawn to suit his racing patten. He led throughout at a Ballarat victory on October 07. DANCIN WITH ELVIS (1) led throughout when he defeated Dulcie Maureen at Charlton last week and is worth thought again from the pole position despite rising in class. LIVERMERE (4) is a very quick beginner and has been placed in all three starts since resuming. She attempted to lead throughout when a close up third at Mount Gambier last outing. BACK: SMOKEN STREPO (6) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: SMOKEN STREPO (6), NORMANDY NUGGET (2), DANCIN WITH ELVIS (1), LIVERMERE (4)

OVERVIEW: ROBERT JOHN (5) was resuming since July when he finished off well for a close second behind Massif Central at Maryborough. He won twice in succession towards the end of his last campaign and he should prove hard to beat again. MATISOFF (6) settled in the second half of the field and came out three horses wide from the 800m when he sustained the run to finish a creditable third behind Dance Fighter at Maryborough last week. A repeat performance will see him going close to winning here. ITGETSBETTER (1) did all of the work in the run and proved to be too strong at Mount Gambier last outing. This is a race of more depth but he is drawn to go well again. MAORIS RETURN (4) ran a game race for second at Horsham when resuming then couldn’t work into the race from a poor draw at Maryborough. He should be reaching his peak form after having two runs back from a spell and is not without a chance. BACK: ROBERT JOHN (5) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: ROBERT JOHN (5), MATISOFF (6), ITGETSBETTER (1), MAORIS RETURN (4)

The two-year-olds combine for the No More Than One Win event, where KOOKY (3) looks extremely hard to beat. She should have enough gate speed to zoom straight to the front, as she did last week in the Group 2 Evicus Final, when run down in the final 50 metres to finish second. A similar performance here would make her very hard to run down. VINCENT THE THIRD (1) showed good ability as an early two-year-old and produced a handy effort last start. He looks the one most likely to knock off the expected favourite if able to follow her everywhere around the pegs. MISS VINCENTINA (2) is going better than her overall form figures suggest, having not been beaten far behind some smart types in very fast time, and could be the one at odds running home strongly. MAJOR SCOTTY (4) and SOLO STITCH (5) have competed in feature races of late but will need to improve on those performances to be in the finish here. Selections: KOOKY (3), VINCENT THE THIRD (1), MISS VINCENTINA (2), MAJOR SCOTTY (4)

An extremely even event over the short trip, where you would expect EVERYTHING BUT THE (1) and IMPERIAL LAZ (3) to contest the early lead. EVERYTHING BETTOR (1) has been in great form working his way through the grades of late before battling against some very handy open class horses last week. If he backs up from that run, he should get every chance from the pole draw. IMPERIAL LAZ (3) copped interference last week when a late scratching but should be suited to the mile distance and, at his best, should be right in the finish. JOHN VINCENT (4) has been a consistent performer since arriving in the state and will look to settle just behind the speed before running home strongly. The rest of the field will be relying on some solid tempo early to allow them to run home over the top, where WE SALUTE YOU (8) looks the pick of them, getting his preferred pegs run. Selections: EVERYTHING BUT THE (1), IMPERIAL LAZ (3), JOHN VINCENT (4), WE SALUTE YOU (8)

COMINSKI LEIS (9) looks to get his chance to put another win on the board from the nice trailing back-row draw. BRIGHTLY BLAZE (5) draws an awkward gate but has been racing well whenever he gets the right run in transit, so will again be hoping for something similar here. VOODOO RANGER (1) and ARRIVAL TIME (3) have been consistently finishing in the minor placings and get draws to their advantage, giving them another chance to break their maiden status. ROCKNROLL MCRAE (7) could be the one at odds, having shown ability at times, but he draws an awkward gate here. Selections: COMINSKI LEIS (9),BRIGHTLY BLAZE (5), VOODOO RANGER (1), ROCKNROLL MCRAE

JILLIBY WORPA (2) was a dominant winner last start when finding the front and running slick time. He may cop some more pressure here from other horses off the front row, including A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (3) and STORMZABREWEN (4), who were both good winners last start but draw outside him here. QUEEN ANAETASIA (7) has been racing well but draws an awkward gate, so may have to be driven more conservatively and hope for some genuine tempo throughout. SPORTZSILK (8) is threatening to break through but also draws awkwardly and will be relying on some luck and better manners to be in the finish. Similar could be said for ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (9), who got it all wrong in the score-up last start but, at his best, could easily be winning here. Selections: JILLIBY WORPA (2), ULTIMATE GLADIATOR (9), A ROCKN NIGHTMARE (3), QUEEN ANASTASIA (7)

An extremely strong 75–105 event here, where CARMEN EMJAY (1) will be looking to use the barrier draw to her advantage. She should have sufficient gate speed to hold the front and, while she rises slightly in class against mostly Free For All horses, the times and sectionals she has been running when narrowly beaten from bad draws recently should make her very hard to run down. WAVES OF CHANCE (5) is expected to push forward from the wide gate to find a position on speed, while tactics could be interesting with his stablemate RAKADAN (7), who normally does his best racing on speed but draws the outside gate here. The class performers of the field include BETTABLACK TIGER (8), MAGICIAN (9) and THE SHALLOWS (10), who are all racing well and will be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to run home strongly into the finish. Selections: CARMEN EMJAY (1), BETTABLACK TIGER (8), MAGICIAN (9), THE SHALLOWS (10),

WHERE IT BEGAN (1) will be looking for back-to-back victories after winning at huge odds in fast time in the three-year-old Guineas last start. He should be able to hold the lead here and run at the tempo he desires, so there is no reason why he can't be winning again. PHLOW JO (2) is racing well and should find a position on speed, making her a genuine each-way chance, as does DOLCE DRAMA (4), who has been racing well without winning in similar grade to what she meets here. SPORT WATCHER (3) should again be looking to earn a cheque for connections from the handy draw, while ALWAYS AURORA (6) and REALLY SMARTIE (7) could be the ones at odds if they are able to get a nice cart into the race from their awkward front-row draws with some tempo on throughout. Selections: WHERE IT BEGAN (1), PHLOW JO (2), DOLCE DRAMA (4), SPORT WATCHER (3)

MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (2) will be looking to take advantage of a good front-row draw to be first to the pegs. SOLO SAFARI (3) broke last start, but his prior form in higher-class races would have him competitive here, and he gets his chance from the nice draw. KUHIO CREST (6) is going well but will need some luck from the wide draw and may look to push forward from the gate in what appears a moderate front row for gate speed. The back-row runners STAROFREMEMBRANCE (9) and DEBT TILL WE PART (10) will be running home strongly as usual if there is any genuine tempo throughout. Selections: MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (2), SOLO SAFARI (3), KUHIO CREST (6), DEBT TILL WE PART (10)

The final race of the day sees the class horses of the field drawn wide on the front row. REMMINGTON (5) was used early when the race was stopped and rerun last week, so happy to forgive that performance. Expect him to hunt forward from the gate and attempt to find the pegs, or at least a position on speed, and ensure a solid tempo throughout. Stablemates SNOWIEWILLREV (6) and IDEN OLIVER (7) bring the next strongest form into the race and look the main dangers, although they may be relying on some early tempo from the runners drawn inside to allow them to run home strongly. IAMAHUNTER (9) was well backed when saluting from the stand last week and, although rising slightly in class, should still be running home strongly into the finish. MONTGOMERY BURNS (8) has been thereabouts of late but will be relying on some luck from the inside back-row draw, while ROCKNALLOVERTHEWORLD (3) looks the best of the Wayne Yole-trained runners after a couple of handy efforts of late and will be looking to make use of his good front-row draw. Selections: REMMINGTON (5), SNOWIEWILLREV (6), IDEN OLIVER (7), IAMAHUNTER (9) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

NOTHING I WANT (3) was unlucky in a mobile start last week. Her recent form before that run was consistent and she should enjoy the return to the stand start today. She will be hard to beat off the front mark. MAORI TATTOO (2) can be a bit all over the place with his form but he finds his sort of race today and he is drawn well off the front mark. LOW LIE THE FIELDS (6) and EMILY MEAGAN (1) are also chances.

ALDEBARAN DEXTA (6) returns to the stand today in an easier race compared to his recent outings. He ran second from the mobile start last week behind MY BAD HABITS and he hit the line very well. He should be hard to beat today after that eye catching run last start. REOFFENDER (1) will enjoy the front mark today and he should be right in the finish. MY BAD HABITS (4) and REGAL ATTIRE (7) are also chances.

STAR OF PATRICK (2) wont find the lead today most likely but he will love the mobile start and he also loves having something to chase. If he can get a nice run in transit he should have too much stamina for IMA DESTROYER in the concluding stages of the races. IMA DESTROYER (1) is racing well and she will love the inside draw but the distance is a concern in a trickier race. FEEL THE MOMENT (3) and MAJESTIC SUMMER (6) are both big chances.

SWEET ARPEGGIO (5) finds her sort of race again today. She was a winner two starts back when she sat in the one out one back position to defeat CAPTAINS DREAM by a short half head. She will be hard to beat today if she can get a run into the race like that. SEA HUNTER (1) will love the inside draw and he looks like he will be the leader. CAPTAINS DREAM (8) and MANDS PEARL (4) are also chances.

NIGHT SPIRIT (5) was a last start winner here at Globe Derby when he defeated ASHANTE PRINCE by 3.8 meters. He is the only runner in this race with consistent and improving form. If he can repeat his run from last week then he should be hard to beat. ROAD STAR (4) is a chance of finding the lead today. If he can get over then he will run a very strong race out in front. SHIREEN (1) and UPRIGHT (6) are also chances.

WEREGOINGTOGETCHA (6) was back to her better form last start when she defeated AMYS BABY ANGEL by 1.2 metres. She is a lot better than what she has been showing recently. If she can improve off her last start win she should be hard to beat today. NEDS BEACH (4) has the potential to be a massive improver today in a race like this. It may pay to keep him safe. TRIGGER (1) and GYM JUNKY (5) are also chances.

DELIGHTFUL DREAM (5) has won two of his last three starts. He defeated ALOHA PRINCESS by 2.2 metres last week after doing it tough outside the leader. Today will be tougher for him but he is a handy horse when he is 100%. GUEST ARTIST (2) has been improving with every South Australian run he has had. He is another where it may pay to keep him safe today. TWIN CONNECTION (9) and ROCKNROLL SPIRIT (6) are also chances.

NORMY (6) finds his sort of race today. His recent run behind PERFECT PLAYGIRL at Globe Derby was solid and he looks ready to win again if he can get a nice run into the race from the tricky draw. WHENIMREADY (7) will struggle from the draw but he does have early speed. He is a threat in a race like this. NORMANS GIRL (11) will be a threat if she gains a start as the emergency. SEASIDE SHOW (8) is racing well but she will need a fair bit of luck from the draw. LIGHTNING BLING (9) looks the next best.

FIRESIDE (10) was impressive here last week at Globe Derby when he had his first South Australia start and ran second behind STORMY MADEM. He made up some ground after being three back along the inside. A repeat of that effort will make him hard to beat today. MY ULTIMATE BANJO (8) is a better horse than his form suggests. He will be a big threat today if he can get some luck from the draw. CAPTAIN MOCKA (6) and RIVERGUM REGALIA (1) are also chances.

ORAMA (1) ran a better race last start when she was beaten 4.5 meters behind WHITESTARCHRISTIAN. She has the good draw today and she must be respected in this sort of race. MEET ME AT THE BEACH (5) finds a much more suitable race today compared to her recent outings. She could easily take this race out. WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (6) and PARISIAN BANDIT (7) are also chances. OVERVIEW:FLEUR BELLA (1) won twice in succession at Mildura prior to a sixth at Swan Hill, where she led out then took cover. She is a fast beginner and she boasts the terrific record of three wins from six starts on the track so she warrants respect. CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (3) began very quickly from a wide draw and ran along at a genuine tempo when he scored at Globe Derby last outing. He is drawn to obtain a prominent position again and is worth an investment. ROJENBYE (7) has the perfect trailing draw behind FLEUR BELLA (1) and is worth a ticket each way. SNEAKY PHILTRA (9) is a versatile mare and recorded a victory at Mildura against similar opposition on October 06 so she cannot be left out of calculations. SELECTIONS: FLEUR BELLA (1), CAPTAIN PAPRIKA (3), ROJENBYE (7), SNEAKY PHILTRA (9)

OVERVIEW:THE LADYBIRD (10) recorded a handy mile rate of 1.57.7 when she scored at Horsham three starts ago and appears to be well placed against this line up. She is capable of sprinting to the line quickly with the right trail forward so being drawn on the second line isn’t a big disadvantage. DAYSIE BROWN (7) will be relying on ELISSAS DELIGHT (1) holding a forward position at the start but her form last preparation would suggest she is capable of being very competitive. DIAMOND KRUSHER (8) was a winner at Mildura on September 04 after she led throughout. She has done well at Mildura this season and has claims despite being drawn on the second line. ELISSAS DELIGHT (1) is a fast beginner and finished fourth after setting the speed over the longer distance two starts ago so she is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: THE LADYBIRD (10), DAYSIE BROWN (7), DIAMOND KRUSHER (8), ELISSAS DELIGHT (1)

OVERVIEW: OUR MONARCH (4) is a South Australian trained pacer, which won a trial at Globe Derby then followed with a third at a Gawler trial performance in handy time. She obviously has ability and strikes a suitable assignment first up. ALWAYS BENEFITS (2) was resuming since June when he worked home well from midfield and finished fourth behind Kaidenboy at Charlton. He is better drawn for this assignment and is not without a chance. LITLMAX (6) is backing up quickly from her performance at Mildura on Friday but she was confidently driven when second at her debut performance and has the ability to feature prominently. LATHER WITH FIRE (10) is also backing up quickly from Friday afternoon’s Mildura meeting and she won a trial at Shepparton prior so she cannot be dismissed. BACK: OUR MONARCH (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: OUR MONARCH (4), ALWAYS BENEFITS (2), LITLMAX (6), LATHER WITH FIRE (10)

OVERVIEW: ACCELERE (5) is yet to miss a place in seven starts for the season and should run his usual honest race. He worked hard from a similar wide draw to find the lead and battled on nicely for second behind the smart juvenile pacer Bettorbust at Mildura last outing. HOOKLINEANDSINKER (6) suffered atrial fibrillation and was retired out of the race at Mildura last outing. He recorded handy time after working forward to find the front at Globe Derby prior so he is worth another chance. LORD MYRMECIA (1) finished off fast when an eye-catching second at Globe Derby on September 22. He is ideally drawn and looms as one of the leading chances. The South Australian trained pacers TWO WAY WONDER (3) and HARLEM TOWN (4) are both worth thought despite being unplaced at their past few attempts and CALF PEN (7) is usually competitive against this class. BACK: ACCELERE (5) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: ACCELERE (5), HOOKLINEANDSINKER (6), LORD MYRMECIA (1), TWO WAY WONDER (3)

OVERVIEW:BAZZAS LEGACY (4) is racing consistently and deserves to break through for a win. He finished third behind Tooram Danny in a stronger race at Swan Hill three starts ago, which is a strong form pointer for this event. WINSHEMAY (9) is the only horse in this race that wasn’t nominated for Friday afternoon’s meeting. She was impressive when winning on debut and was runner up behind the tightly assessed performer Noble Trick at a recent trial effort so she must be respected. KEAYANG SHADOWBOX (8) has been steadily working back into his best form and strikes a winnable assignment now. He wasn’t beaten by far when second behind the classy pacer The Golden Hook at Mildura on October 20. HELLAVA DEAL (7) was competing against stronger opposition when she was last in work. She is awkwardly drawn but should be finding the line well. SELECTIONS: BAZZAS LEGACY (4), WINSHEMAY (9), KEAYANG SHADOWBOX (8), HELLAVA DEAL (7)

OVERVIEW:CEMETERY BAY (1) has been competing against the open class pacers at Mildura and appears to be well graded in this event. His last win at Mildura was in a much harder race (National Rating 60-75) back in August and he is perfectly drawn for this assignment. GOOD BOOTS BINDI (2) is a handy sprinter and is perfectly drawn to gain a trail just behind the speed so she should be dangerous at the end. SHIRLEY NOT (3) has been racing in career best form with three recent Mildura victories to her credit. She is stepping up in grade but she is versatile and should make her presence felt. ROYAL SAXON (6) will need some luck from the wide draw but he ran a strong race for third behind SHIRLEY NOT (3) on October 20 and will go well with normal luck in running. BACK: CEMETERY BAY (1) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: CEMETERY BAY (1), GOOD BOOTS BINDI (2), SHIRLEY NOT (3), ROYAL SAXON (6)

OVERVIEW: HAPPY AS CAN BE (3) finished fourth in a heat of the South Australian Cup then followed with a seventh in the Final. He will enjoy racing against this class and is drawn to go close. CAULONIA TERROR (5) was a winner at Mildura on September 18 and he was unlucky behind Lower Manhattan two starts ago as he was held up behind tiring horses at the 700m mark. He is likely to settle in the second half of the field from his awkward alley but he should be hitting the line strongly. MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2) was placed behind the in-form pacer The Golden Hook two starts ago and wasn’t far away at his latest fifth. He is worth a ticket each way from his good draw. FOXY TWO GLOVES (4) led out then took cover when a game second behind the Emma Stewart prepared Star Vision on Swan Hill Cup night so a bold showing is expected. SELECTIONS: HAPPY AS CAN BE (3), CAULONIA TERROR (5), MY ULTIMATE BILLY (2), FOXY TWO GLOVES (4)

OVERVIEW: SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (1) performed very well at the trials prior to a third behind the smart South Australian pacer Rankine when resuming. He should be building on his fitness and will take beating from the pole position. EAGLEYE (2) has been racing very consistently and ran a game race behind Talknplay at Swan Hill two starts ago, where she was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off solidly. This race is no harder and she worth thought again. HILLTOP CRUNCH (8) has remained undefeated in two starts since resuming from a break and should gain an economical run from his trailing draw so there is no reason why he can’t win again. CLARENDEN ARCADIA (3) and MY ULTIMATE HENRY (6) are both racing well enough to figure in the finish. BACK: SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (1) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: SHUDABOUGHTABOAT (1), EAGLEYE (2), HILLTOP CRUNCH (8), MY ULTIMATE HENRY (6)

OVERVIEW:STORMS (7) is resuming since a debut third but he has appeared to be very sharp at the trials having remained undefeated in three attempts. He zipped home his last quarter in 27.4 seconds at his latest trial success so he is worth following. CRYPTO CROOK (2) commenced from the pole position, was headed off at the start and settled three back on the markers when a fast finishing second at Charlton on debut. She created a good impression first up and should prove hard to beat. ITS HYDROMATIC (1) gained a nice trail and tried hard over the latter stages when third in the same race at Charlton. He possesses early speed and is ideally drawn so he warrants respect. BANGBANG BOBBIE (3) was runner up behind the smart juvenile pacer Lambro Louella at Mount Gambier last outing. He has been runner up twice recently and should be competitive again. HALF AS TOUGH (6) produced a game performance when a fast finishing second at Hamilton then couldn’t work into the race from a poor draw at Charlton. He is worth another chance despite the poor draw. SELECTIONS: STORMS (7), CRYPTO CROOK (2),ITS HYDROMATIC (1), BANGBANG BOBBIE (3)

OVERVIEW:EMILY VINCENT (2) set up a very genuine tempo in the lead and battled on okay for fourth in a slick mile rate of 1.54.5 at Kilmore last outing. She has only been placed once in 20 starts for the season but her efforts since resuming have been encouraging and she is drawn to go well. WICKED MITZI (1) is a fast beginner and is drawn to suit her racing pattern. She was shuffled back on the markers after commencing from the inside of the second row and didn’t have much room in the straight when sixth at Shepparton last outing. WILD CARD (3) has been racing at Metropolitan level and will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. He was a winner at Cranbourne on September 06 and is worth thought again. EL LAZZAR (5) is stepping up in class on his latest performances but he racing in career best form. He led throughout from the pole position and recorded a mile rate of 1.55.0 at Swan Hill last week so he can take the next step forward. SELECTIONS: EMILY VINCENT (2), WICKED MITZI (1), WILD CARD (3), EL LAZZAR (5)

OVERVIEW: LOUS MAMBO (5) settled four back on the markers, moved into the death seat at the 1100m and battled on strongly for third behind Ozzie Tart in the Tatlow Stakes last outing. This race is much easier and he should prove hard to beat again. SWIM SUIT (2) also competed in the Tatlow Stakes and battled at the end, finishing in seventh. His form prior was sound and he led throughout at a Terang victory on October 19 so he is worth another chance. SURETHING (3) began quickly but couldn’t get across to the markers and ended up restraining to find a position on the inside mid-race when a creditable first up second. She should be fitter from that performance and is worth thought. PHILS BOY (4) and XLENDI STAR (6) are both capable of showing up without surprising. BACK: LOUS MAMBO (5) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: LOUS MAMBO (5), SWIM SUIT (2), SURETHING (3), XLENDI STAR (6)

OVERVIEW: TALKNPLAY (5) is stepping up in class from his past three successes but he has been dominating his rivals and is capable of taking the next step forward. He worked to the front and recorded a slick mile rate of 1.55.5 last time out. YANKEE RAIN (7) has also been in winning form and overcame a tough run to score comfortably at Ballarat last week. She is likely to endure a wide trip from the poor draw but she is racing too well to dismiss. JAMES GARNER (3) drew on the inside of the second line, was shuffled to three back on the markers and worked home nicely late for third at Charlton. He should have benefited from that performance and is better drawn so he must be respected. VILLAGE VOICE (6) was caught behind tiring horses before working home well once finding a clear passage at her latest second. She is capable of running into a place again. SELECTIONS: TALKNPLAY (5), YANKEE RAIN (7), JAMES GARNER (3), VILLAGE VOICE (6)

OVERVIEW:BETTOR DOO (1) recorded victories at Shepparton and Melton prior to enduring a tough run and finishing in fourth behind the in-form pacer Talknplay at Swan Hill. He is ideally drawn for this assignment and is capable of returning to winning form. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (2) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of trying to lead throughout. He burst across from a wide draw to find the lead at Charlton and was only run down over the latter stages at his latest second. ONYX (8) missed away, settled last on the markers and finished off nicely via an inside run when fourth (4m) at Ballarat last week. He is likely to gain an economical trip from his trailing draw and is worth an investment. BOND GIRL (7) is terribly drawn and hasn’t raced since July but she was racing well enough last preparation to be competitive against this field. BACK: BETTOR DOO (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: BETTOR DOO (1), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (2), ONYX (8), BOND GIRL (7)

OVERVIEW:MUSCLE VALLEY (10) finished off strongly and ran a great race for second in the Victoria Derby. He was also runner up in the Need for Speed Prince Final and this is a massive drop back in class so he is clearly the horse to beat. HAPPY ESCAPE (5) was runner up twice behind the handy mare Keayang Minnesota before a Maryborough victory, where he set up a slow tempo in the lead. He is racing at his peak form and looms as one of the leading chances again. WHY NOW (11) faces the tough handicap of 40m but he was placed off the same mark at Hamilton last outing so he cannot be dismissed. WHISKEY DAWN (9) continues to race consistently from the standing start and is capable of filling a place. BACK: MUSCLE VALLEY (10) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: MUSCLE VALLEY (10), HAPPY ESCAPE (5), WHY NOW (11), WHISKEY DAWN

OVERVIEW: AVANT GUARD (9) commenced from the handicap of 20m, settled sixth on the outside and came out three horses wide from the 500m when he got home best to score at Maryborough last outing. He commences from the front tape here and should be competitive again. I DREAM OF MILLIE (10) is racing in great form and will prove hard to beat if she can step away safely but she does have an ordinary standing start record. She used plenty of energy early, took cover and battled on well for second in the Matchmaker Mile during the Redwood Carnival. CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (7) has returned from a spell in terrific form and looms as one of the leading chances again. He left a trailing position to move up without cover from the 1100m when third at Maryborough last outing. ROMANTIC NINA (3) made an error in the Maryborough Cup last outing and finished in sixth. She appears to be well placed from the front row and will take beating if she can deliver a fool proof display. SELECTIONS: AVANT GUARD (9), I DREAM OF MILLIE (10), CHAMPAGNE CHARLEY (7), ROMANTIC NINA (3)

OVERVIEW: ZENARIO (5) is a versatile pacer, which has been freshened since a close second behind Places You Don’t in a heat of the Australian Drivers Championship at Globe Derby, where he attempted to lead throughout. He recorded slick time at a Maryborough trial victory last week and should well. ROCKIN GEMMA (4) is racing in career best form having won four of her past five starts with her only miss being in a heat of the South Australian Cup. She broke the track record at Port Pirie three starts ago so she warrants respect. ROADMASTER (10) was placed in a heat of the South Australian Cup before drawing awkwardly and being in the second half of the field throughout in the Final. He is a speedy pacer and should be hitting the line strongly. WORDS (9) has been racing at Metropolitan level and she is likely to find this race to be a little easier. She was shuffled back on the markers and finished sixth (8m) in the Ladyship Cup last outing. TELEMACHUS (1) is ideally drawn and won the 2023 St Arnaud Cup at his only attempt on the track. SELECTIONS: ZENARIO (5), ROCKIN GEMMA (4), ROADMASTER (10), WORDS (9)

OVERVIEW: BLACK OPAL JACK (2) is a tough type, which should be getting fitter after his two starts back from a spell and will appreciate his best draw for a long time so a forward showing is expected. DELIGHTFUL CHARM (8) is resuming from a spell and hasn’t been to the trials but she was competitive at a much higher level when she was last in work. She has the perfect trailing draw so she cannot be dismissed. HUXHAM CHUBB (9) delivered a career best performance when she sustained a long run from last at the 800m to score at Hamilton. This race is no harder and she looms as a strong winning chance again. MISTER JIMARINGLE (7) pushed forward to race without cover and produced a strong performance when he scored at Kilmore last outing. He gets into this race nicely with a concession claim and is worth thought again. The stable mates IMAGINATION ORO (3) and YNOBE NOVA (4) are both fast beginners and have claims in an open race. SELECTIONS: BLACK OPAL JACK (2), DELIGHTFUL CHARM (8), HUXHAM CHUBB (9), MISTER JIMARINGLE (7)

OVERVIEW: BETA THAN LOVE (1) trailed the leader and used the sprint lane when second behind Bettor Doo at Melton last outing. He was narrowly beaten at his two starts prior and he strikes a very suitable assignment now. THE REGULATOR (8) finished off well when a close second behind Wichita Kansas at Ballarat last outing. He has the perfect trailing draw behind BETA THAN LOVE (1) and is one of the leading chances again. ARRAPS (5) possesses early speed and attempted to lead throughout when fourth behind Reason To Laugh at Kilmore last outing. He has been placed in three of his past five starts so he is worth a ticket each way. DULCIE MAUREEN (2) produced a career best performance when she was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished off well at her latest second. She is nicely drawn and a repeat performance could see her filling a place again. BACK: BETA THAN LOVE (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: BETA THAN LOVE (1), THE REGULATOR (8), ARRAPS (5), DULCIE MAUREEN (2)

LIGHTYEAR (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead early in this race from the good draw. He should find this considerably easier than some of his recent outings and looks a clear standout in this race. STORMY MIDNIGHT (9) was able to keep up quite well last time out in a much stronger race taken out by Fit And Ready last time out. He ran a reasonable race his start prior when finishing a well beaten second behind Aimees Alias. EL JEFE (4) ran well for third last time out behind Aimees Alias at Redcliffe. He draws a touch awkwardly in this race but should settle close enough and can be running on late. TEN AND TWO (7) ran well enough for sixth last time out behind Aimees Alias. He doesn’t look a winning hope on paper but can be running into the minor money if the race is run suit. SELECTIONS: LIGHTYEAR (1), STORMY MIDNIGHT (9), EL JEFE (4), TEN AND TWO (7) SUGGESTED BET: LIGHTYEAR (1) to win.

DEAL IT VINNIE (5) looks a clear standout on class in this race and should be very hard to beat despite drawing widest. He sat without cover three starts ago and was able to prove too good at this track rating good time. CHECKINGOUTTHEBILL (6) should get a reasonable run through in this race behind the speed. He ran well two starts ago when running on strongly into second behind Threefiveone. TRAVELNFEELIN (1) has landed the ideal draw in this race and can lead before having options from there. He raced without cover last time out and was well beaten as a result there. FLUTTERING ANGEL (8) returns from a spell in this race. She was forced to race without cover in her latest outing and battled on reasonably there for fifth. SELECTIONS: DEAL IT VINNIE (5), CHECKINGOUTTHEBILL (6), TRAVELNFEELIN (1), FLUTTERING ANGEL (8) SUGGESTED BET: DEAL IT VINNIE (5) to win.

CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (9) didn’t have much luck last time out when sitting without cover before fading out of it late. He looks well graded in this race and despite the poor draw he can figure in the finish. SAYCHELLES (7) was able to secure a good run off the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. She ran well last time out when getting back and running on behind Courageous Leo. SKIPPERS SWAN SONG (8) draws awkwardly in this race and will likely need the race run to suit. Ran a reasonable fourth two starts ago at this track after sitting close to the speed behind Copy Writer. NO FAMILY LIKEMINE (1) draws well in this race and has good gate speed but has seemingly been much better recently when driven with a sit. SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN OH CAPTAIN (9), SAYCHELLES (7), SKIPPERS SWAN SONG (8), NO FAMILY LIKEMINE (1) SUGGESTED BET: SAYCHELLES (7) to win.

ALWAYSBJOY (6) draws quite awkwardly in this race inside the back row but does appear to be a clear standout on class and should find this a considerable drop in grade on her recent outings. She took on a strong race last time out and was able to run third there behind Ideal Bronski and Ruggards Gee Tee. FITZROY (3) took on a strong trial taken out by Captain Shuffles recently at Albion Park and is likely to have taken good benefit from the outing. He ran well two starts ago behind Surreal Moran in the consolation of the Redcliffe Derby. SWEET ROCKY (7) did a lot of work two starts ago and was able to prove too good there for Bonnies Cam. He draws to do no work early in this race and can be driven to the speed of the race. ROCK NIEN (2) has the draw advantage on a number of his key rivals in this race and may look to press forward and find the lead in the early stages of the race. He was running on well last time out into third after getting a long way back in the run at Redcliffe. SELECTIONS: ALWAYSBJOY (6), FITZROY (3), SWEET ROCKY (7), ROCK NIEN (2) SUGGESTED BET: ALWAYSBJOY (6) to win.

SKINNY HORACE (1) has good gate speed and has previously led and run well in races. He didn’t have a lot of luck last time out in a race taken out by Dipped In Silver at Redcliffe. VICTREE ATOM (6) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader SKINNY HORACE (1). He ran well three starts ago finishing second behind Rollyarrrz. He should get every chance from a favourable draw. SKYLAR BREE (8) secured a good run off the speed last time out and was flashing home there into third behind Beau Steele. She should get a good run off the speed again in this race and can be running on well late. MAJOR MISCHIEF (10) was a winner two starts ago first up from a spell when leading all the way at Redcliffe. He comes into this race third up from a spell and can be running on if the race is run to suit. SELECTIONS: SKINNY HORACE (1), VICTREE ATOM (6), SKYLAR BREE (8), MAJOR MISCHIEF (10) SUGGESTED BET: SKINNY HORACE (1) to win.

MARTIN MAGIC (2) has excellent gate speed and may be able to zip across at the start of this race and find the lead. He sat close to the speed last time out and battled on fairly there for fifth behind Tralee Snickas who has since won again. JAMES ALFRED (6) should secure a good run behind the speed in this race. He should find this a lot easier than his latest outing when finishing second behind Fire And Passion. QUEEN TIDE (1) has moderate gate speed and should settle close to the speed in this race. She trialled up reasonably recently at this track and should be better for the outing. COMMODORE JUJON (7) should get a good run off the speed and should be running into it late. He secured a good run behind the speed last time out and was able to run a good second there behind Greatgreat Boulder. SELECTIONS: MARTIN MAGIC (2), JAMES ALFRED (6), QUEEN TIDE (1), COMMODORE JUJON (7) SUGGESTED BET: MARTIN MAGIC (2) to win.

CHARLIE CHUCKLES (1) showed good gate speed to lead last time out at Redcliffe and was just run down late by Redcliffe champion Ashlee Nitro. He should be able to lead again in this race and should be very hard to run down at Marburg. KINGSBURY (6) should get a good run behind the likely leader in this race. He drew poorly last time out getting back and was running on late into third in a race taken out by Party Changer. ABSOLUTELY STOKED (7) should get a good run through behind the speed in this race from a soft trailing draw. She was able to lead and win three starts ago at this track and distance. LULU LUCIFER (8) should get a good run off the speed in this race. She generally races well at this track and seems to like being sat up and saved for one run. SELECTIONS: CHARLIE CHUCKLES (1), KINGSBURY (6), ABSOLUTELY STOKED (7), LULU LUCIFER (8) SUGGESTED BET: KINGSBURY (6) to win.

SPECIALANDIKNOWIT (2) should have the speed to get across to the lead in the early stages. He battled on well last time out behind The Real Rocketman over 2138 at Albion Park. GOTTA DREAM (3) should be able to work across to the running line and settle close in this race. She ran well for second behind October Racketeer after finding the leaders back early in that race. SAINT LOUIS BEAT (5) draws wide in this race but looks to be one of the class runners in this field. He got back two starts ago and was able to beat his stablemate Rosie Pollen. EIFFEL FROM HEAVEN (1) should get a good run just behind the speed in this race from the ideal draw. She has drawn poorly on both outings in QLD so far and should run a better race. SELECTIONS: SPECIALANDIKNOWIT (2), GOTTA DREAM (3), SAINT LOUIS BEAT (5), EIFFEL FROM HEAVEN (1) SUGGESTED BET: SPECIALANDIKNOWIT (2) to win.
